tasks.task: Build a 90-day email plan

items.when: When you have the list export, past results and goals and need a 90-day plan
Before planning, to see which automated flows are missing or clash
When you must decide how often to send, with a story and an offer for each week
When the plan treats the list as a target, not people who gave permission

tasks.task: Plan the month's sends and topics

items.when: In the last week of the month, to plan, write and review the month ahead
When sends must fit real dates and team capacity, with audiences and owners
When ideas have run dry, to get topics and a hundred one-point email ideas
When the client wants a month that sells without leaning on discounts

tasks.task: Write a newsletter issue

items.when: When you have this period's news, a tip or story and one thing to ask for
When the issue should start from customer questions and store news
When the issue needs a personal story, to get three different drafts
When the issue is written and needs subject lines and preview text to choose from
When the newsletter goes out weekly and each issue should be checked against the voice
Before sending, to get counts, cuts and a ship or fix verdict
When the issue reads like company news and should start from the reader's concern

tasks.task: Write a campaign or promotional email

items.when: When you have a campaign goal and product facts and need the email block by block
When the campaign is a sale that runs over several emails and texts
When the offer needs a deadline or limit that is real, and the lines to say it
When the email is written and needs honest subject lines to choose from
When the email is drafted, to get cuts, a pacing map and a verdict

tasks.task: Write and test subject lines and preview text

items.when: When one send needs subject lines, preview text and a plan to test them
When you want twenty options across several angles
When you want to test them properly, with sample sizes and win rules

tasks.task: Plan and write a welcome series

items.when: When you need the trigger, filters, timing, exit rules and the emails themselves
When it is a store welcome with an offer, best sellers and a brand story
When the series should teach first and sell later, with a review built in
When each welcome email needs subject lines to choose from
When the series has numbers, to see which emails to protect and which to fix

tasks.task: Write a lead nurture series for one lead type

items.when: When a lead type needs a six-message series with timing and exit rules
When the series needs a free offer to start it, to compare ideas and pick one
Before writing, to give each message one job that sets up the next
When stalled leads should get useful information before any ask
When the series is live, to see where leads stop reading

tasks.task: Follow up after a quote, enquiry or event

items.when: When a warm lead went quiet and needs a short series that helps first and stops
When you want a second version of the series to compare tone and length
When follow-ups come after a show or webinar and promises must be tracked
Before each message goes, to cut it to one clear ask

tasks.task: Build cart and browse abandonment flows

items.when: When the flow needs triggers, filters and exit rules written for the client's tool
When shoppers leave a cart or checkout, with timing and a rule for discount codes
When visitors look at products and leave, for a flow that offers a discount last
When a store has no flows and they should go live one at a time, safely
When each flow email needs subject lines to choose from
When flows are live, to find missing steps and rules that clash

tasks.task: Write post-purchase, review and reorder emails

items.when: When buyers need thank-you, how-to, add-on and check-in emails after an order
When the product needs teaching, for a 14-day plan after the first order
When you must decide when to ask for a review and how to word it
When products run out on a schedule and reminders should be timed to each buyer
When the emails are drafted, to check triggers, timing and exit rules

tasks.task: Win back lapsed contacts and sunset the rest

items.when: When you have order history and want a win-back flow and a clean list together
When the flow should be timed to how buyers really reorder
When non-openers hurt sending, for a three-email goodbye and a monthly routine
When the win-back email needs subject lines that get a second look
When the flow has run, to see which emails earn their place

tasks.task: Write a launch email sequence

items.when: When a launch has a close date and needs the full run of emails with resends
When writing the closing emails, to keep every deadline and limit true
When each launch email needs subject lines to choose from
When a launch email is drafted, to get cuts and a ship or fix verdict

tasks.task: Build a list segmentation plan

items.when: When segments must follow the plan's goals and the size of the list
When you need engaged, buyer and exclusion groups written as clear rules
When you have an order export, to group customers by recency, frequency and spend
When one email should show different blocks to different groups

tasks.task: Grow the list with forms, popups and clear consent

items.when: Before a form, checkout opt-in or lead magnet goes live, to check the wording
When a store needs a popup, with desktop and mobile specs, copy and tests
When the form needs a reason to sign up, to compare free offers
When the list came from mixed sources, to see who gave real permission
When you must show who agreed to email and SMS and who did not

tasks.task: Check domain set-up, sender rules and consent

items.when: When you have DNS records, headers and results to check against the sender rules
When mail bounces or lands in spam and you want the records and headers read
When you want a second scored read of the settings and DNS with exact fixes
When SPF, DKIM or DMARC is missing and needs setting up step by step

tasks.task: Recover inbox placement after a drop

items.when: When clicks fall sharply, customers report spam or bounces show block codes
When you have open rates and engaged counts, to score the damage and plan recovery
When you want a guided run to a recovery plan, an engaged list and a sunset flow

tasks.task: Move platform or sending domain and warm it up

items.when: When the client switches platform, adds a sending subdomain or changes the From
After the move, to confirm the records and headers on a real message
Before importing the list, to flag bad, role-based and throwaway addresses
When the move is to Klaviyo and you must know what its flows and data can do

tasks.task: Set list hygiene rules and a sunset policy

items.when: When the rules must follow how contacts were collected and what they agreed to
When you need the engagement rule and the monthly routine written down
When you must find risky addresses before they hurt the sender reputation

tasks.task: Build a responsive HTML email template

items.when: Before coding, to turn the copy and goal into a section-by-section layout
When you want two HTML designs with previews to choose between
When the template must render in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and Yahoo and on phones
When a design is ready, to score layout, links and file weight

tasks.task: Build transactional email templates

items.when: When an app or store needs coded receipts, resets and notices with a sending setup
When subscriptions need renewal reminders and order confirmations written
When the templates are coded, to test them across inboxes and screen readers

tasks.task: Fix an email that breaks, with a dark mode and access pass

items.when: When an email breaks in Outlook or on phones and you need the cause and the fix
When text is hard to read in dark mode, to check each colour pair
After the fix, to re-score layout, links and weight

tasks.task: Read email results and say what to change

items.when: Monthly or after a drop, to read clicks, orders and complaints, not opens
When you want a second scored read of last month's numbers
When you need revenue and orders by campaign from the store's own order links
When the client asks what email really earns, to hold a group back and compare
When flows should be reviewed monthly and the weakest one rebuilt

tasks.task: Plan email tests and read them

items.when: When you need a ranked queue of tests with sample sizes and win rules
When a test has run, to check the split and say whether the result is real
When the test is on subject lines and needs a plan over the next few sends

tasks.task: Write SMS to run beside email

items.when: When texts should cover welcome, cart, win-back and promos, with consent rules
Before a text goes, to check its cost, rule flags and score

always.when: At the start of a client, to build a voice guide from their own documents
Before any email goes for approval, to fix lines that sound machine-written
When an email states a number, date or result you cannot trace to the client
Before every send, to catch typos, wrong names and product terms spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the job is retention across email, SMS, loyalty and offers, not email alone
When the emails lead to a sales or landing page that also needs writing
When the template needs a visual design, banners or product images
When segments or results need cohort and repeat-purchase analysis from order data
When DNS records must be changed and nobody on the client side knows how
When consent rules across regions need a formal review

gaps: No library item plans a warm-up schedule for a new sending domain or IP, day by day
No library item plans a move between email platforms: what to export, rebuild and test, and in what order
No library item fixes an email that breaks in Outlook or on phones; only the kit skill covers it
No library item checks an HTML email for dark mode and screen readers; the library has only a colour check
No library item checks sign-up form consent wording by region; only the kit prompt does
No library item reads DNS records and message headers together; the two library checks need pasted settings
No library item refreshes a tired newsletter: new format options, sections and a reader survey
No library item offers clearly different SMS versions to compare
No library item builds a preference centre or unsubscribe page
Tool guides cover Klaviyo only; nothing for Mailchimp, Brevo, ConvertKit or inbox testing tools
